linked_files.kpi_rules: kpi_rules.json -- join on id (or parent_id) for detection conditions
linked_files.solutions: solutions.json -- join on id for recommended fix and standards reference

reasoning_flow.description: How to determine the root cause(s) for one specific anomaly, in order.
steps: 1. Priority 1 (Resource Limitation): Cell Congestion (C01), then Poor Spectral Efficiency (C02).
2. Priority 2 (Coverage & Radio Quality): Weak Serving Cell (C03), then Interference (C04).

3. Priority 3 (Outage / eNodeB Fault): Serving Cell / eNodeB Fault (C05, requires a declared RLF -- not yet reachable without rach_reason), then Outage / Unattributed (C06, a throughput-collapse proxy that does NOT distinguish serving-cell vs neighbor-cell fault).
4. Priority 4 (Mobility): Handover Problem (C08), then Access Problem (C09).
5. If any subcategory in steps 1-4 matched, the anomaly's root cause is that subcategory's id, plus every supporting-evidence id that also matched. Stop.

6. If nothing matched in 1-4: Priority 5 MIMO (C10), then Priority 6 Carrier Aggregation: Weak Secondary Cell (C11), SCell Release & Deactivation (C12), CA Inactive/Disable (C13). Stop at first match.
7. If nothing matched through C13, assign C14 (Radio-limited) if it holds, else C15 (Inconclusive) -- the definitive last-resort reason.

evaluation_mode_definitions.MATCH_ALL_KPI_CONDITIONS: The subcategory's own gate requires every one of its defining conditions to hold at once.
evaluation_mode_definitions.MATCH_ANY_KPI_CONDITION: The subcategory holds several independent alternative explanations; any one is sufficient.
evaluation_mode_definitions.note: Regardless of mode, supporting-evidence ids are always evaluated independently once the gate has fired, and collected as supporting_evidence. They never gate the parent themselves.

output_display_rule.category_field: For every cause, 'category' in the output is this cause's broad taxonomy category (e.g. 'Resource Limitation', 'Coverage & Radio Quality') -- with one deliberate exception: for C04 (Interference), 'category' is instead set to the fuller descriptive label 'Radio Link Failure (Interference)', so category and cause_name aren't near-duplicates for that one entry.
output_display_rule.cause_name_field: The subcategory's clean short name (e.g. 'Weak Serving Cell', 'Interference', 'Cell Congestion'), not the more technical internal headline name.

causes_list.name: PRB Allocation / Capacity-Limited
causes_list.reason_template: This anomaly is capacity-limited: the UE had confirmed download demand, was using {rb_utilization_pct}% of available RB capacity across {carrier_count} carrier(s), falling {throughput_gap_p75} Mbps below expected throughput -- with link quality still healthy (CQI {lte_cqi}, MCS {lte_mcs}), confirming the shortfall is a resource ceiling, not a radio problem.

causes_list.name: High Load
causes_list.reason_template: Cell PRB utilization ({cell_prb_utilization_pct}%) exceeded the congestion threshold.

causes_list.name: Low Rank
causes_list.cross_check_note: Also the defining signature of C10 (MIMO Rank Fallback). If this is the dominant supporting evidence with only borderline utilization, check C10 before treating this purely as capacity congestion.
causes_list.reason_template: Average Rank Indicator ({avg_rank}) restricted throughput under high resource allocation.

causes_list.name: High Active Users
causes_list.note: No active_user_count field exists in any dataset used so far, and there is no universal fixed threshold either -- published congestion studies show the connected-user count at which a cell hits 80% PRB utilization varies nearly 2x cell-to-cell. Would need a per-cell relative baseline, not a fixed number.
causes_list.reason_template: High concurrent active user count ({active_user_count}) competing for PRBs.

causes_list.name: No CA
causes_list.cross_check_note: Also the defining signature of C13 (CA Inactive/Disable). If this is the dominant supporting evidence with only borderline utilization, check C13 before treating this purely as capacity congestion.
causes_list.reason_template: Carrier Aggregation unavailable/unconfigured to distribute resource load.

causes_list.name: Low BW
causes_list.reason_template: Low operational channel bandwidth ({dl_bandwidth_mhz} MHz) bottlenecking overall capacity.

causes_list.name: Scheduler Under-Grant
causes_list.reason_template: Confirmed demand with only {rb_utilization_pct}% RB utilization despite healthy throughput-per-RB -- the link is fine, the scheduler withheld RBs it could have granted.

causes_list.name: Low Traffic / Demand / Low Buffering Status
causes_list.reason_template: Buffer status reports indicate low user payload demand, resulting in under-scheduling.

causes_list.name: Low MCS
causes_list.reason_template: Modulation and Coding Scheme ({dl_mcs}) under-allocated relative to link capability.

causes_list.name: Low SINR
causes_list.reason_template: Low SINR ({lte_sinr} dB) driving conservative link adaptation.

causes_list.name: High BLER
causes_list.reason_template: High Block Error Rate ({lte_bler}%) forcing scheduler down-grants.

causes_list.name: Weak Serving Cell
causes_list.reason_template: Serving RSRP was {lte_rsrp} dBm, in the Poor coverage band -- weak signal alone is sufficient to explain the degradation; RSRQ, MCS, and BLER below are consequences of it, not independent gates.

causes_list.name: Low RSRP
causes_list.reason_template: RSRP measured {lte_rsrp} dBm.

causes_list.name: Low RSRQ
causes_list.reason_template: RSRQ measured {lte_rsrq} dB, also degraded (expected under weak coverage, not a separate interference signature).

causes_list.name: Cell-Edge Sample
causes_list.reason_template: This sample's own RSRP ({lte_rsrp} dBm) falls in the cell-edge band, consistent with the Poor-coverage classification above.

causes_list.name: Low MCS
causes_list.reason_template: Scheduled MCS was {lte_mcs}, consistent with the weak link.

causes_list.name: High BLER
causes_list.reason_template: BLER was {lte_bler}%, consistent with the weak link.

causes_list.name: Weak Serving Cell (Direct Coverage Hole)
causes_list.reason_template: Direct physical coverage hole causing severe signal loss (RSRP far below threshold across repeated passes at this location).

causes_list.name: Radio Link Failure (Interference)
causes_list.reason_template: Serving RSRP was {lte_rsrp} dBm (acceptable), but SINR was {lte_sinr} dB (degraded) -- a signature of another signal competing on the same resource rather than weak coverage, corroborated by CQI {lte_cqi} and RSRQ {lte_rsrq}.

causes_list.name: Low SINR
causes_list.reason_template: SINR measured {lte_sinr} dB, in the Poor band, despite adequate RSRP.

causes_list.name: Low CQI
causes_list.reason_template: CQI measured {lte_cqi}, degraded despite adequate signal power -- checked ahead of RSRQ.

causes_list.name: Poor RSRQ
causes_list.reason_template: RSRQ measured {lte_rsrq} dB, below the acceptable-quality band despite adequate RSRP.

causes_list.name: High BLER
causes_list.reason_template: BLER was {lte_bler}%, degraded despite adequate signal power.

causes_list.name: High Noise
causes_list.note: Requires an uplink/downlink noise-floor measurement (e.g. RSSI decomposition); this field is not yet present in the incidents file.
causes_list.reason_template: Elevated noise floor degrading overall link budget.

causes_list.name: Co-/Adjacent-Channel Interference
causes_list.note: No interference-source classification or spectrum-analysis data exists in any dataset used so far -- there is no actual detection condition behind this, it's a plausible cause without evidence to confirm it.
causes_list.reason_template: Co-channel or adjacent-channel interference degrading signal quality despite adequate RSRP.

causes_list.name: Coverage Overshoot / Cross Coverage
causes_list.note: Requires cross-referencing this cell's configured coverage boundary/antenna azimuth against where the sample was taken -- not derivable from KPI values alone.
causes_list.reason_template: Serving cell overshooting its intended coverage boundary, creating uncoordinated overlap and interference at this location.

causes_list.name: Cell / Hardware Outage
causes_list.reason_template: A Radio Link Failure was declared while this UE's own radio conditions (RSRP {lte_rsrp} dBm, SINR {lte_sinr} dB) were normal -- not explained by coverage or interference, pointing at the serving cell/eNodeB itself.

causes_list.name: Passive Redirection
causes_list.note: Requires an OSS redirection/cause-code log, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: Redirection triggered by eNodeB degradation or active fault.

causes_list.name: Power Control Failure / Limitation
causes_list.note: Requires eNodeB power-amplifier/alarm telemetry, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: eNB power amplifier limitation or dynamic power control error.

causes_list.name: Power Ratio DL Offset Error
causes_list.note: Requires eNodeB downlink power-configuration data, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: Downlink power allocation offset misconfiguration.

causes_list.name: System High Traffic Release
causes_list.note: Requires an RRC release cause-code log, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: eNB forced RRC connection release due to extreme system overload.

causes_list.name: Neighbor Relation Issues
causes_list.note: Requires the eNodeB's configured Neighbor Relation Table, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: Missing or corrupted neighbor definitions causing drop.

causes_list.name: Neighbor List Incomplete
causes_list.note: Requires the eNodeB's configured Neighbor Relation Table, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: Target cell omitted from eNodeB NRT (Neighbor Relation Table).

causes_list.name: Normal RB Utilization
causes_list.reason_template: Cell PRB utilization was {cell_prb_utilization_pct}%, ruling out congestion as an alternative explanation for the collapse.

causes_list.name: Normal CQI/MCS
causes_list.reason_template: CQI {lte_cqi} and MCS {lte_mcs} were both in the healthy range, ruling out a link-adaptation limitation.

causes_list.name: Normal BLER
causes_list.reason_template: BLER was {lte_bler}%, within the normal target band, ruling out a radio-quality explanation.

causes_list.name: Outage
causes_list.reason_template: A throughput/session collapse occurred while this UE's own radio conditions (RSRP {lte_rsrp} dBm, SINR {lte_sinr} dB) remained normal -- pointing to a network-side service disruption rather than a radio-quality issue.

causes_list.name: Active Energy-Saving / Sleep Mode
causes_list.note: Requires an OSS energy-saving/sleep-mode state flag, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: Energy-saving feature forcing cell or carrier into sleep mode.

causes_list.name: Hardware Failure
causes_list.note: Requires BBU/RRU/backhaul hardware alarm data, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: BBU, RRU, or backhaul transmission hardware failure.

causes_list.name: Paging Failure
causes_list.note: Requires MME/paging-channel counters, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: Paging channel congestion or MME paging payload drop.

causes_list.name: Serving Cell RB Utilization Increase
causes_list.reason_template: This serving cell's RB utilization rose to {cell_prb_utilization_pct}%, above its own recent baseline, in the same window -- consistent with absorbing redirected load, though this alone can't confirm the load came from a failed neighbor rather than normal traffic growth.

causes_list.name: Neighbor Cell Availability Drop
causes_list.reason_template: Neighbor cell availability score dropped to {neighbor_cell_availability}% -- suggestive of a neighbor-side issue, but not independently confirmed without real neighbor-cell traffic/alarm data.

causes_list.name: Handover Problem
causes_list.reason_template: This anomaly sits in a handover-adjacent window with a mobility-pattern signature, rather than a static radio or capacity issue.

causes_list.name: Ping-Pong Handover
causes_list.reason_template: {handover_count} handovers within a 5-second window with a dwell time below the ping-pong threshold -- rapid cell toggling, checked first as the most distinct and unambiguous pattern.

causes_list.name: Wrong Neighbor Relation
causes_list.reason_template: This eNodeB has shown the 'stayed on the weaker cell during handover' pattern across multiple separate episodes -- a persistent site-level pattern, checked before a one-off Late Handover so a recurring problem gets the more specific, actionable label.

causes_list.name: Late Handover
causes_list.reason_template: Handover trigger delayed, forcing communication on weak serving signal -- a one-off occurrence at this site, not yet a confirmed recurring pattern.

causes_list.name: Unprepared Target Cell
causes_list.note: Requires a target-cell admission/rejection event log, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: Handover attempt to unprepared or rejected target cell.

causes_list.name: High Speed
causes_list.reason_template: UE speed ({ue_speed_kmh} km/h) exceeds the mobility parameter optimization window -- a contextual tag that can accompany whichever pattern above fired, since fast mobility makes all of them more likely.

causes_list.name: RACH Issues
causes_list.reason_template: Random Access Channel preamble failure or high contention.

causes_list.name: Uplink Interference
causes_list.note: Requires an uplink RSSI/noise-rise measurement at the eNodeB, not present in UE-side data.
causes_list.reason_template: High UL RSSI/noise rise preventing eNodeB preamble detection.

causes_list.name: High RACH Transmission Power
causes_list.note: Requires RACH transmit-power logging, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: UE hitting maximum RACH transmit power without receiving RAR.

causes_list.name: Rank Fallback / Poor Spatial Multiplexing
causes_list.reason_template: SINR was {lte_sinr} dB (Excellent band) but Rank Indicator dropped to 1 -- Rank-1 is expected only under poor SINR, so this points to antenna correlation or a MIMO-path issue.

causes_list.name: Non-Matching Rank and Transmission Mode
causes_list.note: Requires the UE's configured Transmission Mode from RRC signaling, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: Configured Transmission Mode conflicts with reported Rank Indicator.

causes_list.name: Antenna Fault / Open Path
causes_list.note: Requires an antenna-system alarm (VSWR/feeder), not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: VSWR alarm, feeder cable fault, or physical antenna branch failure.

causes_list.name: Low Rank Detection / Adaptability
causes_list.reason_template: Link adaptation algorithm restrictively holding low rank.

causes_list.name: Low DL Throughput Cell
causes_list.reason_template: Cell-wide MIMO performance degradation across all connected UEs.

causes_list.name: Inter-Band CA MIMO Limit
causes_list.note: Requires per-band CA layer configuration detail beyond the aggregate KPIs present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: MIMO spatial multiplexing limited on active inter-band CA layers.

causes_list.name: Intra-Band CA MIMO Limit
causes_list.note: Requires per-band CA layer configuration detail beyond the aggregate KPIs present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: MIMO spatial multiplexing limited on active intra-band CA layers.

causes_list.name: Weak Secondary Cell
causes_list.reason_template: Carrier Aggregation was active but underperforming: SCell RSRP was {scell_rsrp} dBm / SINR {scell_sinr} dB -- the fault traces to the secondary carrier's own radio quality, not CA configuration.

causes_list.name: Low SCell SINR
causes_list.reason_template: SCell channel quality ({scell_sinr} dB) insufficient to sustain CA.

causes_list.name: Low SCell RSRP
causes_list.reason_template: SCell coverage ({scell_rsrp} dBm) below secondary carrier addition threshold.

causes_list.name: Interference SCell
causes_list.note: Requires interference-source classification, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: High interference specific to secondary component carrier.

causes_list.name: Low / Zero SCell Allocated RBs
causes_list.reason_template: SCell was allocated only {scell_rb_count} RBs despite CA being active.

causes_list.name: SCell Release / CA Inactive Mid-Episode
causes_list.reason_template: Secondary carrier deactivated mid-session, forcing single-carrier fallback.

causes_list.name: High SCell BLER
causes_list.reason_template: High SCell BLER ({scell_bler}%) before deactivation, a plausible trigger for the release.

causes_list.name: Low SCell CQI
causes_list.reason_template: SCell CQI ({scell_cqi}) was also degraded before deactivation, corroborating a radio-quality-driven release rather than a scheduling artifact.

causes_list.name: Abnormal SCell Release Event / Connection Drop
causes_list.note: Requires SCell release MAC Control Element or RRC connection-drop event logs, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: Abnormal secondary carrier release or connection interruption disrupting SCell stability.

causes_list.name: CA Inactive / Disable
causes_list.reason_template: Carrier Aggregation was never active for this UE/session (carrier_count == 1 throughout) -- no aggregated bandwidth was available, and no SCell radio evidence exists since there was no SCell to measure.

causes_list.name: SCell Activation Attempt Failed
causes_list.note: Requires SCell activation MAC Control Element event logs, not present in any dataset used so far.
causes_list.reason_template: SCell activation MAC CE command timed out or failed, leaving CA inactive.

causes_list.name: Radio-Limited (Link Adaptation)
causes_list.reason_template: Sub-optimal link adaptation performance with degraded BLER ({lte_bler}%) or low CQI ({lte_cqi}).

causes_list.name: No Confirmed Demand / Inconclusive
causes_list.reason_template: This sample had no confirmed active download demand at the time it was flagged, or matched no condition anywhere in the tree above -- the radio was idle, not faulty. This is the definitive last-resort reason and should never be counted as a network root cause.
